summary: Implemented and durably tested a browser-compatible helper that validates and retains only opaque Primary Chat correlation identifiers work_item_id + return_path in sessionStorage. It rejects malformed IDs/paths, rejects public/private non-return refs, requires queued ingress, rejects ref/return_path mismatch, preserves reload state, accepts exact replay idempotently, fails closed on one-sided replay conflicts, ignores private payload fields, and exposes explicit privacy flags. The helper is not yet wired into ingress-v1.js/input-module-v1.js, so the original end-to-end correlation-loss boundary remains partially unresolved and DONE is not claimed.

truth_boundary: This productive unit implements and verifies the bounded opaque-correlation primitive only. It does not claim that the current ingress/input-module path already retains the identifiers end-to-end, nor any private E2E, Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion, or public storage of private content.
